bio: Lace Market Hotel is a swish enclave in the heart of Nottingham which boasts a swanky restaurant and bar, the perfect environment to enjoy a leisurely Afternoon Tea.  Whether you are looking to pop in for a cheeky G&T, would like to indulge in one of our mixologists signature cocktails, or have booked in for Afternoon Tea, the Saint bar offers the perfect contemporary setting to enjoy all the above in style.  With a selection of finger sandwiches, homemade miniature cakes and delicious pastries lovingly prepared by their Head Chef, Lace Market Hotel's fresh Afternoon tea is served Thursday to Saturday 2pm – 5pm, and must be booked in advance.  Nottingham Rail Station is just a ten-minute walk from Lace Market Hotel.
